feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 June 2026 11:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 08 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind later.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving complex low to the northwest of the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly west 3 or 4, occasionally force 5 in places, backing southwest this afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 in all waters this evening, further increasing 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate at first, building mainly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, scattered showers spreading from the west later this afternoon & evening, possibly becoming more widespread for a while tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, veering west 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight later.


##Weather##

Showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
